items.source: NOTE: With @Profile on @Bean methods, a special scenario may apply: In the case of overloaded @Bean methods of the same Java method name (analogous to constructor overloading), an @Profile condition needs to be consistently declared on all overloaded methods. If the conditions are inconsistent, only the condition on the first declaration among the overloaded methods will matter. @Profile can therefore not be used to select an overloaded method with a particular argument signature over another; resolution between all factory methods for the same bean follows Spring's constructor resolution algorithm at creation time. Use distinct Java method names pointing to the same bean name if you'd like to define alternative beans with different profile conditions; see ProfileDatabaseConfig in @Configuration's javadoc.
items.translation: 注意： 在 `@Bean` 方法上使用 `@Profile` 时，可能会出现一种特殊情况：如果存在多个具有相同 Java 方法名的重载 `@Bean` 方法（类似于构造函数重载），则必须在所有重载方法上一致地声明 `@Profile` 条件。如果条件不一致，只有第一个重载方法中的条件才会生效。因此，不能利用 `@Profile` 来选择具有特定参数签名的重载方法；对于同一 bean 的所有工厂方法之间的解析遵循 Spring 在创建时使用的构造函数解析算法。 如果您希望定义具有不同 profile 条件的替代 bean，请使用指向相同 bean name 的不同 Java 方法名；请参阅 @Configuration 的 javadoc 中的 `ProfileDatabaseConfig`。

items.source: If a @Configuration class is marked with @Profile, all of the @Bean methods and @Import annotations associated with that class will be bypassed unless one or more of the specified profiles are active. A profile string may contain a simple profile name (for example "p1") or a profile expression. A profile expression allows for more complicated profile logic to be expressed, for example "p1 & p2". See Profiles.of(String...) for more details about supported formats.
items.translation: 如果 `@Configuration` 类上标记了 `@Profile`，则除非激活了一个或多个指定的 profile，否则将与该类关联的所有 `@Bean` 方法和@Import注解都会被跳过。profile 字符串可以包含简单的 profile 名称（例如 `"p1"`）或 profile 表达式。profile 表达式允许表达更复杂的 profile 逻辑，例如 `"p1 & p2"`。有关支持的格式的更多详细信息，请参阅Profiles.of(String...)。

items.source: A profile is a named logical grouping that may be activated programmatically via ConfigurableEnvironment.setActiveProfiles(String...) or declaratively by setting the spring.profiles.active property as a JVM system property, as an environment variable, or as a Servlet context parameter in web.xml for web applications. Profiles may also be activated declaratively in integration tests via the @ActiveProfiles annotation.
items.translation: Profile 是一个命名的逻辑分组，可以通过 ConfigurableEnvironment.setActiveProfiles(String...) 进行程序化激活，或者通过设置 spring.profiles.active 属性作为 JVM 系统属性、环境变量或在 Web 应用的 web.xml 中作为 Servlet 上下文参数进行声明式激活。Profile 也可以通过集成测试中的 @ActiveProfiles 注解进行声明式激活。

items.source: This is analogous to the behavior in Spring XML: if the profile attribute of the beans element is supplied, for example, <beans profile="p1,p2">, the beans element will not be parsed unless at least profile 'p1' or 'p2' has been activated. Likewise, if a @Component or @Configuration class is marked with @Profile({"p1", "p2"}), that class will not be registered or processed unless at least profile 'p1' or 'p2' has been activated.
items.translation: 这与 Spring XML 中的行为类似：如果为 `` 元素的 `profile` 属性提供了值，例如 `<beans profile="p1,p2">`，则除非至少激活了 'p1' 或 'p2' 配置文件，否则不会解析该 `` 元素。同样地，如果某个 `@Component` 或 `@Configuration` 类被标记为 `@Profile({"p1", "p2"})`，则除非至少激活了 'p1' 或 'p2' 配置文件，否则该类不会被注册或处理。

items.source: If no profile is active using one of those options, a default profile is enabled as a fallback. The name of the default profile is "default". This can be changed via ConfigurableEnvironment.setDefaultProfiles(String...) or declaratively by setting the spring.profiles.default property as a JVM system property, as an environment variable, or as a Servlet context parameter in web.xml for web applications.
items.translation: 如果未使用这些选项中的任何一个激活配置文件，则启用默认配置文件作为回退。默认配置文件的名称为"default"。可以通过ConfigurableEnvironment.setDefaultProfiles(String...)更改，或者通过声明方式设置spring.profiles.default属性作为 JVM 系统属性、环境变量或在 Web 应用程序的web.xml中作为 Servlet 上下文参数。

items.source: If a given profile is prefixed with the NOT operator (!), the annotated component will be registered if the profile is not active — for example, given @Profile({"p1", "!p2"}), registration will occur if profile 'p1' is active or if profile 'p2' is not active.
items.translation: 如果给定的配置属性前缀有 NOT 运算符（!），则当该配置属性未激活时，将注册带注解的组件——例如，给定 @Profile({"p1", "!p2"})，若配置属性 'p1' 已激活或配置属性 'p2' 未激活，则将执行注册。

items.source: When defining Spring beans via XML, the "profile" attribute of the <beans> element may be used. See the documentation in the spring-beans XSD (version 3.1 or greater) for details.
items.translation: 通过 XML 定义 Spring Bean 时，可使用 "profile" 属性指定 <beans> 元素。有关详细信息，请参阅 spring-beans XSD（版本 3.1 或更高版本）中的文档。

items.translation: @Profile 注解可以以以下任意方式使用：

items.source: If the @Profile annotation is omitted, registration will occur regardless of which (if any) profiles are active.
items.translation: 如果省略了 `@Profile` 注解，注册将无论激活哪些（或任何）配置文件都会发生。

items.source: The set of profiles for which the annotated component should be registered.
items.translation: 应注册该注释组件的配置文件集。

items.source: as a meta-annotation, for the purpose of composing custom stereotype annotations
items.translation: 作为元注解，用于组合自定义的立体注解。

items.source: Chris Beams, Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Chris Beams, Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen

items.source: as a type-level annotation on any class directly or indirectly annotated with @Component, including @Configuration classes
items.translation: 作为任何直接或间接标注了 `@Component` 的类（包括 `@Configuration` 类）的类型级注解。

items.source: as a method-level annotation on any @Bean method
items.translation: 作为任何 `@Bean` 方法的**方法级注解**。
